_comment: Tests the 'did you mean' message format with 3+ suggestions. A bare 'theme' group exists alongside 'theme/light', 'theme/dark' and 'theme/contrast', and an alias written ON THE BARE GROUP points at a path under it that has no token there — so all three mode-qualified siblings resolve and are offered. The referencing token sits on the bare group for the same reason as in tokens-unresolvable-alias.json: inside a mode set this alias is the shape the engine now resolves on its own (#564).

color.$description: BROKEN: targets the logical group, which has no token at this path.
